title: The Collapse is Starting: Is this the Black Swan?
speaker: Kevin Paffrath

macro_themes.view: Rising CoreWeave CDS is a self-reinforcing doom loop and a sideshow, not a systemic black swan.
The real risk is the labor market, which looks fine now but won't last as agentic AI improves.
AI is a bubble that will eventually pop, but not starting with CoreWeave.

calls.reason: Despite a weak balance sheet and a shift away from training compute, he thinks bankruptcy fears (64% implied default) are overdone; Nvidia or others will bail it out via dilution or loans.
calls.quote: I don't see this as systemic. I see this as a buy the dip opportunity. This is not the beginning of the end.

notes: He states he has no CoreWeave position; 'buy the dip' is contrarian vs CDS pricing. No price levels given.
